name: ConcatAndCastMhaK
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import json
import os


def run(k_nope, k_pe, out_dtype=None):
    assert k_nope.dim() == 3 and k_pe.dim() == 3, f'k_nope/k_pe 应为 3D, got k_nope.shape={k_nope.shape!r}, k_pe.shape={k_pe.shape!r}'
    T, H, nope_dim = k_nope.shape
    T2, H_pe, rope_dim = k_pe.shape
    assert T == T2, f'token 数不一致: k_nope.shape={k_nope.shape!r}, k_pe.shape={k_pe.shape!r}'
    assert H_pe == 1, f'k_pe 的 head 维必须为 1（共享广播）, got k_pe.shape={k_pe.shape!r}'
    assert nope_dim > 0 and rope_dim > 0
    if out_dtype is None or out_dtype == "same":
        out_dtype = k_nope.dtype
    elif isinstance(out_dtype, str):
        out_dtype = getattr(torch, out_dtype, out_dtype)
    k = torch.empty(T, H, nope_dim + rope_dim, dtype=out_dtype, device=k_nope.device)
    k[..., :nope_dim] = k_nope
    k[..., nope_dim:] = k_pe
    return k
